turns.question: Over the six weeks from Monday 17 August to Sunday 27 September 2026, which day of the week brought in the most revenue, and how much?
turns.answer: Sunday brought in the most revenue, 2,423.75 EUR in total across the Sundays from 17 August to 27 September 2026 (Thursday was next at 2,383.25 EUR). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
